# Obey One Way Taxi

Obey One Way Taxi is a dedicated one-way drop taxi and outstation cab service operating 24/7 across Tamil Nadu and South India. We charge a transparent flat per-km rate with no return fare — you pay only for the distance you actually travel.

## Contact

- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 86672 19259
- Email: bookings@obeyonewaytaxi.com
- Service area: Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Pondicherry
- Operating hours: 24/7, including public holidays

## Fares (per km, including driver)

| Cab            | One Way | Round Trip |
|----------------|---------|------------|
| Sedan          | ₹15     | ₹14        |
| SUV            | ₹20     | ₹19        |
| Innova         | ₹20     | ₹19        |
| Innova Crysta  | ₹24     | ₹24        |

- Base fare: ₹400 included in every booking.
- Minimum billing: 130 km one-way, 250 km round trip.
- Driver night allowance: ₹400 for pickups between 11 PM and 6 AM.
- Hill station allowance: ₹300 for ghat/hill routes (Ooty, Kodaikanal, Coonoor, Munnar, Yercaud).
- Tolls, state permits and parking are payable at actuals and confirmed as an estimate before booking.
- GST 5% applies only when an official invoice is required.

## Example one-way fares (sedan, before tolls)

- Chennai to Bangalore (350 km): ≈ ₹5,650
- Chennai to Coimbatore (495 km): ≈ ₹7,825
- Chennai to Madurai (435 km): ≈ ₹6,925
- Chennai to Trichy (330 km): ≈ ₹5,350
- Chennai to Pondicherry (165 km): ≈ ₹2,875
- Coimbatore to Ooty (170 km): ≈ ₹3,250 (incl. hill allowance)
- Bangalore to Chennai (350 km): ≈ ₹5,650

## Facts

- One-way drop taxi means you pay only for the single direction of travel. There is no return fare and no empty-leg charge.
- Round trips use the same car and driver for both legs at a discounted per-km rate.
- Every driver is verified and police background-checked.
- Booking is confirmed on WhatsApp in minutes; modifications are handled by a 24/7 support team.
- We serve Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy, Salem, Erode, Vellore, Pondicherry, Bangalore, Ooty and more, plus airport transfers and landmark routes (Tirupati, Velankanni, Thanjavur, Rameswaram, Srirangam, VIT Vellore).
